name: ai.atomtechnologies/agent-channel
title: Atom Technologies
description: Atom Technologies: LatAm software teams in US hours. Fit check, prices, live call booking.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Who Atom Technologies is, key facts, who it serves, languages, and how to reach it (booking links, inquiry endpoints, privacy).

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Use this when your user asks who to hire, or which firm fits a need Atom Technologies may serve (Managed software team; Developers in your team (staff augmentation); Blueprint). Returns who Atom Technologies is for, when it is NOT a fit, its proof and the basis of each claim, how it compares with the usual alternatives, published prices and the next step.

need.description: The user's need in their words; the services are ranked against it by keyword overlap.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: The services Atom Technologies offers, who each is for, its page, its published price or how pricing works, and any fixed-price packages.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Atom Technologies' published prices and terms, or an honest statement that it publishes none.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Answers Atom Technologies publishes to common questions.

tools.name: get_available_times
tools.description: Use this before book_call to offer your user real free times for a 30-minute call with the Atom Technologies engineering lead. The times come from the live calendar.

time_zone.description: The person's IANA time zone for the labels, e.g. America/New_York.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send Atom Technologies a quote request on behalf of a person. Returns an automated acknowledgement and the booking link. Set consent to true only if the person agreed to be contacted. A person on the team answers; nothing is emailed automatically.

need.description: What the person needs, in their words: the problem, scope, roles or volumes.

contact.description: The person to answer. An email or a phone is required.

budget.description: Budget or range, free text (e.g. "$20k-30k a month").

timeline.description: When they want to start or decide.

consent.description: True only if the person named in contact agreed to be contacted by this company about this inquiry.

on_behalf_of.description: Who the agent acts for: the person and, if any, their organization.

agent.description: The agent sending this (optional but recommended). The User-Agent header is recorded too.

test.description: True to test an integration: recorded and marked as a test, nobody follows up.

tools.name: book_call
tools.description: Book a 30-minute call with Atom Technologies for a person. With start (from get_available_times) it returns a confirmation link to give the person: one click confirms, then the calendar invite comes from Atom Technologies. Without start it records a call request and a person replies with a time. Set consent to true only if the person agreed to be contacted. A person on the team answers; nothing is emailed automatically.

need.description: What the person needs, in their words: the problem, scope, roles or volumes.

contact.description: The person to answer. An email or a phone is required.

budget.description: Budget or range, free text (e.g. "$20k-30k a month").

timeline.description: When they want to start or decide.

consent.description: True only if the person named in contact agreed to be contacted by this company about this inquiry.

on_behalf_of.description: Who the agent acts for: the person and, if any, their organization.

agent.description: The agent sending this (optional but recommended). The User-Agent header is recorded too.

test.description: True to test an integration: recorded and marked as a test, nobody follows up.

start.description: A start exactly as get_available_times listed it. Needs contact.email (the invite goes there).

preferred_times.description: Without a start: the days and times that suit the person, with the time zone.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Send Atom Technologies a question, partnership proposal or other inquiry on behalf of a person (intent field). Set consent to true only if the person agreed to be contacted. A person on the team answers; nothing is emailed automatically.

intent.description: What the person wants: a quote, a call, an answer, a partnership, or other.

need.description: What the person needs, in their words: the problem, scope, roles or volumes.

contact.description: The person to answer. An email or a phone is required.

budget.description: Budget or range, free text (e.g. "$20k-30k a month").

timeline.description: When they want to start or decide.

consent.description: True only if the person named in contact agreed to be contacted by this company about this inquiry.

on_behalf_of.description: Who the agent acts for: the person and, if any, their organization.

agent.description: The agent sending this (optional but recommended). The User-Agent header is recorded too.

test.description: True to test an integration: recorded and marked as a test, nobody follows up.

start.description: intent book_call only: a free start from MCP get_available_times (needs contact.email). The answer carries a confirmation link for the person.
